items.exampleZh: 我的手機會自動存照片。

items.exampleEn: This lake is artificial. People made it.
items.exampleZh: 這座湖是人工的，是人建造的。

items.exampleEn: Please speak softly in the hospital.

items.exampleEn: I don't need a fancy phone. A simple one is fine.

items.sentenceEn: The door opens automatically when you walk to it.
items.sentenceZh: 你走到門前，門就會自動打開。

items.audioEn: We had a fantastic time at the beach last weekend.
items.audioZh: 我們上週末在海邊玩得很開心。
items.questionZh: 他們上週末在哪裡玩得很開心？

items.sentenceEn: This movie is not suitable for young children.
items.sentenceZh: 這部電影不適合年幼的孩子看。

items.sentenceEn: She sang softly to the baby.

items.stemEn: These flowers are not real. They are ____.
items.stemZh: 這些花不是真的，是人造的。

items.stemEn: The lights turn off ____ at midnight.

items.passageEn: Last Sunday, I went to a science exhibition with my class. It was fascinating! We saw a machine that can draw pictures automatically. There was also a room with artificial rain, and our teacher spoke softly so we could hear it. After that, we had lunch at a fancy restaurant near the museum. Most importantly, everyone learned something new. It was a fantastic day.
items.passageZh: 上週日，我和班上同學去看科學展。好有趣喔！我們看到一台會自動畫圖的機器。還有一個會下人造雨的房間，老師說話很小聲，好讓我們聽到雨聲。之後，我們在博物館附近一家高級餐廳吃午餐。最重要的是，每個人都學到了新東西。那真是很棒的一天。

options: 博物館附近一家高級餐廳

rubricZh: 「很吸引人」可寫，例如 fascinating、interesting 等
可寫例如 is fascinating、a fascinating book

items.promptZh: 這份工作很有趣，更重要的是，離我家很近。
referenceEn: This job is interesting, and more importantly, it is near my home.
The job is fun. More importantly, it's close to my home.
rubricZh: 用 more importantly 表示「更重要的是」
「離我家很近」可寫，例如 near my home、close to my house 等
